summary.text: Nathan Carlow is a Republican state representative from Buxton, Maine, who has represented District 137 since December 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
His career experience includes work as a director of candidate engagement for the Cumberland County Republican Committee.

paragraphs.text: Carlow lives in Buxton, Maine, and graduated from Bonny Eagle High School.
He earned a B.A. in political science and government from the University of Southern Maine in 2018.

Carlow's career experience includes working as an accounts payable specialist with East Coast Construction Management, as director of candidate engagement with the Cumberland County Republican Committee, and as a consultant.
He took office in the Maine House on December 6, 2022.
Ballotpedia lists him on the Appropriations and Financial Affairs Committee for 2023-2024 and the Bills in the Second Reading Committee for 2025-2026.
